acquisition_method.evidence: Samples were analyzed by a data independent acquisition (DIA) LC-MS/MS method.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were lysed in 6 M urea in 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, reduced with 10 mM D,L-dithiothreitol and alkylated with 40 mM iodoacetamide.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were lysed in 6 M urea in 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, reduced with 10 mM D,L-dithiothreitol and alkylated with 40 mM iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were digested overnight with sequencing grade modified trypsin (Promega).

ionization_type.evidence: Liquid Chromatography Electrospray Ionization Tandem Mass Spectrometry (LC/ESI-MS/MS) was used in the human cell lines HS578T, MDA-MB-231, MCF10A, and PC3.

The LC-ESI-MS/MS analysis was performed on a nanoflow HPLC system (Easy-nLC1200, Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to the Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nano-electrospray ionization source.

labeling.evidence: Label free quantification of protein abundances enabled comparison of the expression levels of talin 1 and talin 2 within each cell line.
